model.sampler: Original adjacent-step stochastic DDPM, not respaced/DDIM

display.point_markers: Identical2pixel marks for every point cloud, all points inside common ROI, no thinning/density matching/GT-neighbour filtering
display.camera: Original matched camera; full FOV, aspect ratio preserved, letterboxed, no exposure/contrast edits
display.lidar: Same ground-removed LiDAR reference cache used by manuscript, never fed into inference
display.playback_note: Presentation playback only; not inference throughput or a real-time claim
display.sequence_cuts: Between the3 explicit segments only; no missing or reordered frame IDs within each segment
